title: Greenpeace Pet‑Friendly 3‑Bedroom Gulf‑Front Home
meta_description: Settle into Greenpeace, a pet‑friendly 3‑bedroom Gulf‑front Seaside home with iconic architecture, expansive views, and direct access to the beach and town.
description_expanded: 21 WEST RUSKIN STREET*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.Prime Location in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Greenpeace, a beloved family cottage perfectly positioned in Seaside, Florida—just 115 feet from beach access and one block from the Seaside Amphitheater and Town Square. With more than 35 shops, restaurants, galleries, and cafés within easy walking distance, this home offers one of the most walkable and convenient locations in Seaside. A private driveway with off-street parking for two vehicles adds rare convenience in this highly sought-after area.Guests are welcomed by a screened-in front porch featuring a picnic table, ideal for alfresco meals, morning coffee, or regrouping after a day at the beach.Open Living, Dining & Renovated KitchenThe main level offers an inviting, open layout designed for gathering and relaxation. The living area features newly updated furnishings, including a loveseat, accent chairs, and a queen sleeper sofa, while the bench-style dining area comfortably seats up to eight.The fully renovated kitchen is outfitted with stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, a four-burner electric stove, mounted microwave, and dishwasher—everything needed for easy family meals and entertaining. A full guest bathroom with a tub/shower combination is also located on this level.First-Floor Primary SuiteThe spacious king primary suite is located on the first floor and includes a cozy seating area, ample storage, and a large mounted flat-screen TV. The renovated ensuite marble bathroom features dual vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, offering a spa-like retreat after a day in the sun.Second-Floor Guest Rooms & Outdoor LivingUpstairs, the queen guest bedroom includes its own mounted flat-screen TV and a private ensuite bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and generous storage. This room shares access to the furnished open-air front porch, which spans the length of the home.The third bedroom is a custom-built bunk room, thoughtfully designed with built-in storage, reading lights, and its own wall-mounted TV. Featuring a twin-over-queen bunk, this room sleeps three and also opens onto the expansive front porch.The porch is furnished with two Adirondack chaise loungers and a rocker, creating the perfect spot for afternoon reading or an evening glass of wine.Steps from the Best of SeasideBeyond the beach just steps away, Greenpeace places you moments from everything that makes Seaside iconic—from the amphitheater’s weekly events and farmers markets to wine bars, gourmet groceries, and art galleries. With its unbeatable location, updated interiors, and generous outdoor spaces, this Seaside cottage offers a relaxed yet connected coastal getaway for families and groups alike.As an added bonus, the accompanying ‘Greenback’ guesthouse may be rented with ‘Greenpeace’ or separately, providing yet another level of luxury and privacy to guests within this spectacular setting. Located right on West Ruskin Street, the ideal setting and features of this beach cottage are hard to beat. *A non-refundable pet fee of $275.00 (plus sales tax) is required. Pets Allowed: Please select under pet options and the $275 pet fee will be added to the reservation for online bookings during the checkout process.* 5 night minimum Spring, Summer, & Spring Break; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $150 pet fee for three-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No dog over 70 lbs. FEATURES1,569 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion115 feet or a 1-minute walk to beach accessPrivate driveway with off-street parking for two carsOutdoor showerMedia in every bedroomPet-friendly (up to 70 lbs.)Peacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking information: Two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitSTR23-002048
